Package org.drip.regression.nonlinear

Non-linear Least Squares Regression
Author:
Lakshmi Krishnamurthy
  • Interface Summary
    Interface Description
    LeastSquaresEstimator
    LeastSquaresEstimator exposes the Functionality for Non-linear Least-Squares Estimation.
  • Class Summary
    Class Description
    GaussNewtonEstimator
    GaussNewtonEstimator implements the Non-linear Least-Squares Regression using the Gauss-Newton Algorithm.
    ImplicitTrustRegion
    ImplicitTrustRegion holds the Implicit Trust Regions used in Non-linear Least Squares Regression.
    LeastSquaresHessianControl
    LeastSquaresHessianControl holds the Hessian Proxy and Line Search Settings used in the Least-Squares Hessian Algorithm.
    LeastSquaresHessianEstimator
    LeastSquaresHessianEstimator implements the Non-linear Least-Squares Regression using the Hessian of the Sum of Squared Residuals.
    LeastSquaresIterationDiagnostics
    LeastSquaresIterationDiagnostics holds the Results of a Least-Squares Iteration Run.
    LeastSquaresRun
    LeastSquaresRun holds the Results of a Least-Squares Estimation Run.
    LeastSquaresRunDiagnostics
    LeastSquaresRunDiagnostics holds the Results of a Least-Squares Diagnostic Run.
    R1R1Sample
    R1R1Sample holds the Sample of (R1, R1) Realizations.
    R1ToR1EnsembleResidualSquared
    R1ToR1EnsembleResidualSquared holds the Squared Residuals corresponding to an Ensemble of (x, y) Pairs for a given Parameterized Objective Function.
    R1ToR1Residual
    R1ToR1Residual holds the Residual corresponding to a (x, y) Pair for a given Parameterized Objective Function.
    SampleResidualJacobian
    SampleResidualJacobian holds the Gauss Newton "J" Matrix - the Array of Sample Residual Jacobians and their Transpose.
